SPECIAL ABILITIES: 1/day, Calca can cast two spells using one standard action. Both of the spells must have the same standard action casting time. The Calca can make any decisions concerning the spells independently of each other. These spells are cast simultaneously and must both be stated before any effects occur. A Calca receives a +4 bonus on caster level checks made to overcome spell resistance with these two spells.

Once every 1d2+1 rounds, Calca can cast one single Blue Mage spell randomly up to 4th level spell. Roll a 1d4, 1 for 1st lvl spells (DC 14), 2 for 2nd lvl spells (DC 15), 3 for 3rd lvl spells (DC 16), and 4 for 4th lvl spells (DC 17) then decide on a dice to roll for each spell list.

Calca gains the benefit of extra hit points from Charisma instead of size due to being a construct which means he can also be healed by normal means. He also gain feats and skills due to having an Intelligence. His saves are also consider Good unlike most constructs.

curation.summary: Calca is packaged as an FFD20 NPC actor with 31 generated item(s) across 8 populated mechanics categories.
rulesDecisions: Actor data preserves the source statblock in biography and builder flags before any Foundry runtime hydration.
Only true feats, spells, and inventory placeholders are eligible for compendium lookup during import; creature-specific special abilities remain custom generated features.
Racial hit dice are generated from the creature type and source hit dice instead of creating class levels.
Source defensive text is mapped into FFD20 trait fields while unusual FF defenses remain preserved as custom text.
Natural attack items use source attack totals, source damage dice, and manual extra attacks for full-attack routines.
Spell and spell-like ability lines create spell placeholders that should hydrate from installed FFD20/PF spell compendiums.
Skill ranks are reverse-calculated from source totals after ability modifiers, racial modifiers, size modifiers, and class-skill bonuses.
